cases.scenario: All source additions, crop uptake, purge, sample exports and final inventory are known for N, P and K; each element closes within its declared tolerance.
cases.reason: A fully specified synthetic mass balance should close exactly and remain explicitly synthetic.

cases.scenario: A fertilizer addition is recorded only as aggregate product mass; the product assay and recipe are missing.
must_not_infer: Zero contribution for an unmeasured element
cases.reason: Aggregate fertilizer mass cannot be silently decomposed into elemental inventories without a composition source.

cases.scenario: Two nutrient solutions have the same measured EC but different synthetic ionic compositions, including different nitrate and sodium concentrations.
must_not_infer: Equal EC means equal nutrient inventory
A nutrient recipe from EC alone
cases.reason: This negative control proves aggregate conductivity does not uniquely identify elemental composition.

cases.scenario: Source water introduces sodium at a level outside the declared target envelope while EC remains within the configured EC range.
must_not_infer: Acceptable water chemistry from EC alone
cases.reason: Ion-specific water quality can violate the crop profile even when bulk EC appears acceptable.

cases.scenario: A qualified laboratory result is positive in a shared drainage return; edible-leaf sample from one location is negative.
must_not_infer: The crop is safe because one leaf sample is negative
All facility batches are proven contaminated
The positive result's viability or extent beyond the assay scope
cases.reason: A positive result in a crop-contact return path requires batch/domain adjudication; one negative leaf sample does not clear it.
cases.claim_ceiling: Synthetic food-safety evidence-routing case; no live pathogen work.

cases.scenario: All submitted samples are negative, but they cover one reservoir point and omit return lines, crop roots, drainage, tools and post-harvest zones.
cases.reason: Negative evidence is bounded by matrix coverage, sampling locations and detection limits.

cases.scenario: PCR assay target is detected, but viability is not resolved and no viability assay or culture result is available.
cases.reason: A molecular target and viable-organism status are distinct evidence claims.

cases.scenario: A 16S community profile changes across crop cycles but no defined hazard, pathogen assay or plant disease endpoint is positive.
must_not_infer: Disease suppression solely from community shift
Food safety from a low or changed total bacterial count
cases.reason: Microbiome change is not itself a defined hazard or a validated biological-control result.

cases.scenario: A plant-pathogen signal is detected in roots, but no human foodborne-pathogen assay is positive.
must_not_infer: Human foodborne pathogen from plant-pathogen result
cases.reason: Plant disease and human foodborne hazards are different hazard categories with different endpoints.

cases.scenario: A cleaning event is logged, but no independent post-cleaning samples or assay results are available.
cases.reason: A procedure log is not evidence that the outcome was achieved.

cases.scenario: A proposed return pipe links the crop nutrient reservoir to an MTES/minewater domain without a qualified treatment and separation boundary.
cases.reason: Different water domains require explicit source quality, treatment, intended-use and authority evidence.

cases.scenario: A system claims zero discharge but omits filter sludge, cleaning waste, sampling exports and contaminated-batch disposal from the boundary.
cases.reason: A zero-discharge claim is invalid when relevant waste/export streams are omitted.

cases.scenario: A treatment train recovers water and nutrients, but recovered solution chemistry and microbiological quality are not assessed for reuse.
cases.reason: Recovery quantity and recovered-product suitability are separate qualifications.

cases.scenario: Harvest weight and crop quality are within agronomic specifications, but an environmental hazard result is unresolved.
must_not_infer: Automatic release from a harvest-controller pass
cases.reason: Food-safety disposition is a separate authority decision from harvest service and crop quality.

cases.scenario: A qualified positive result appears in a shared manifold that physically connects zones A and B during the relevant crop cycles; zone C has an independently validated isolated supply and return.
must_not_infer: Zone C has no risk without its own evidence
The exact contaminated lot set without crop/lot/flow timestamps
cases.reason: Exposure follows a qualified hydraulic path and time interval; hold the evidenced connected lots while preserving the independently isolated zone's separate evidence boundary.

cases.scenario: A positive environmental result occurs in zone A; zone B is physically isolated with independently verified supply/return separation and its own complete valid sample set.
must_not_infer: Automatic release of zone B without responsible authority
Universal absence outside the sampled scope
cases.reason: The affected domain is isolated; keep zone A on hold and evaluate zone B only within its own complete, current evidence and authority process.

cases.scenario: A microbiological assay result is reported, but chain of custody is broken and sample identity cannot be linked to a specific water path, crop zone or batch.
must_not_infer: The affected batch or zone without source identity
cases.reason: A result without valid sample identity and custody is not admissible for exact lot or facility attribution; preserve it for investigation and recollection.

cases.scenario: A cleaning/sanitation event is followed by negative samples, but the assay detection limit is above the predeclared decision threshold and the return-line biofilm locations were not sampled.
must_not_infer: Sanitation efficacy at the required threshold
Food release solely from these samples
cases.reason: Negative results with insufficient detection sensitivity and incomplete matrix coverage cannot verify the sanitation outcome.

corpus_claim_ceiling: Synthetic adversarial routing corpus only. It does not implement assays, define a pathogen-handling procedure, validate sanitation or certify food safety.
